tagline: Innovative medicines for central nervous system disorders
hero_kpi_rationale: ONAPGO is a new product launched in 2025 with demand exceeding expectations, representing a key structural growth driver despite supply constraints. It is the primary driver of recent growth.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned from drug sales and collaboration agreements.
kpis.description: Growth is driven by Qelbree, GOCOVRI, and collaboration revenue related to ZURZUVAE.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Calculated from total revenue ($718.952 M) and cost of revenue ($74.562 M). Slight improvement compared to 2024.
kpis.signal: High gross margin typical of the pharmaceutical sector.

kpis.name: R&D Expenses
kpis.description: The decrease is due to lower clinical costs for SPN-820, partially offset by SPN-817 and the Biogen collaboration.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in 2025, despite new programs.

kpis.name: Selling, General and Administrative Expenses
kpis.explanation: Costs related to sales, marketing, and company management.
kpis.description: Selling and marketing expenses increased by 27% (to $288.651 M), and general expenses by 109% (to $196.912 M) in 2025.
kpis.signal: Significant increase linked to the ONAPGO launch and the Sage acquisition.

kpis.name: Qelbree Sales
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the Qelbree drug for ADHD.
kpis.description: Qelbree is the main driver of organic growth in 2025.
kpis.signal: Strong growth supported by volume and pricing.

kpis.name: Trokendi XR Sales
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the epilepsy and migraine drug.
kpis.description: Major negative impact on total sales in 2025.
kpis.signal: Sharp decline due to generic erosion.

kpis.name: ONAPGO Launch
kpis.explanation: New product launched in 2025 with demand exceeding supply.
kpis.description: ONAPGO generated $17.254 M in 2025 following its Q2 launch. Demand exceeds supply due to single-source suppliers in Europe.
kpis.signal: Very strong demand despite supply constraints. Launched in Q2 2025, supply provided by a single European partner.

kpis.name: ZURZUVAE Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue related to the Sage acquisition and the ZURZUVAE product.
kpis.description: Stable collaboration revenue of $53 M in 2025 following the acquisition of Sage in July 2025.
kpis.signal: New revenue stream post-Sage acquisition in July 2025.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions risks related to cybersecurity incidents that could negatively impact its financial condition, operating results, and reputation.

risks.title: Patent Litigation
risks.score_rationale: The company is involved in significant patent litigations, including with generic manufacturers (Ajanta Pharma) regarding Trokendi XR, which could have a material impact on its financial results.

risks.title: Competition and Generic Erosion
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive sector with significant generic erosion affecting its established products (Trokendi XR -33%, Oxtellar XR -59%).

risks.title: Regulation and Compliance
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations, including those related to patents, drug marketing, and compliance with healthcare laws (HealthCare Reform Law).

risks.title: Patent Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on patents to protect its products. Trokendi XR patents expire in 2027-2028, which could have a significant negative impact.

risks.title: ONAPGO Supply Constraints
risks.score_rationale: ONAPGO, the key new product, faces supply constraints due to single-source suppliers in Europe, limiting the ability to meet demand.

risks.title: Reputation and Healthcare Compliance
risks.score_rationale: The company could be exposed to risks of non-compliance with healthcare laws (HealthCare Reform Law, federal and state regulations), which could affect its reputation.

ai_positioning.summary: The company SUPN mentions artificial intelligence only in a regulatory context. The Biden Administration Executive Order on the safe development of AI in healthcare was rescinded by the Trump Administration order in January 2025. There is no mention of internal deployment or operational use of AI.
evidence: Biden Administration Executive Order on Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy Development and Use of AI (October 30, 2023) - addressed use of AI in healthcare
Trump Administration order 'Removing Barriers to American Leadership in Artificial Intelligence' (January 23, 2025) - rescinded Biden order
